description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'Plugins_DeliveryLimitations_ArrayData' that extends 'Plugins_DeliveryLimitations'. It handles array data overlap checking for delivery limitations, including methods for data initialization, flattening, expanding, display, and input validation. It also manages specific operators '=~' and '!~' for data comparison.

classes.name: Plugins_DeliveryLimitations_ArrayData
classes.description: An abstract class for handling array-based delivery limitations with data overlap checking, supporting specific operators and data formatting methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object and sets up operation translations.

methods.name: displayArrayData
methods.description: Abstract method to display array data, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the object with data, flattening it if it's an array.

methods.name: setAValues
methods.description: Sets the array of possible values for the limitation.

methods.name: _flattenData
methods.description: Converts array data into a flattened string format for storage.

methods.name: _expandData
methods.description: Expands a flattened string back into an array of data.

methods.name: displayData
methods.description: Prepares data for display by expanding, displaying, and re-flattening.

methods.name: _preCompile
methods.description: Preprocesses data for compilation, flattening the expanded array.

methods.name: _getAPositiveValues
methods.description: Extracts positive values from data, considering '!=' and '!~' comparisons.

methods.name: checkInputData
methods.description: Validates input data; currently always returns true.
